- **3V3A hop gap was 0.200 mm, not 0.34 mm.** I restored the earlier drawing and allowlisted it with that measured reason.

findings.finding:
The new copper was not fully gap-checked, and C15 is incomplete against its own stated scope.

Why:
- F8's newgap.py crashed at the first via, so none of the seven new or moved vias was measured.
- Where it did run, it printed only each track's nearest neighbour.

Four sub-0.2 mm gaps made by fix-pass-7 copper are missing from C15:
- (a) BAT_IN crossbar via (9.45, 109.8) – R123.2 (GND), B.Cu, 0.188 mm. This is new copper and the most serious short pair on the list: it would short the unswitched pack, behind only the external 15 A fuse.
- (b) CAM_5V_SENSE's new In2 diagonal – 3V3 via (32.33, 33.042), 0.190 mm (was 1.87 mm).
- (c) and (d) IMU_INT1's redrawn B.Cu SW leg – SERVO1_MCU via (27.1, 68.2) and SERVO2_MCU via (26.3, 67.4), 0.191 mm each, on the same line as before.

The same gap hides new BAT_IN neighbours of all three actuator-switch control nets on B.Cu:
- via (10.2, 107.8), under Q122's body: 0.349 mm from Q122.1 (ACT_EN) and 0.400 mm from Q122.3 (ACT_DRV);
- via (9.95, 104.05): 0.262 mm from ACT_GATE's track.

What a short would do (Inference, from the netlist):
- BAT_IN–ACT_EN turns Q122 on with the power switch open, which powers RAW_ACT, the servos and the ARM-plug side of the pyro bus while switched off; the pyro gate stays off.
- BAT_IN–ACT_DRV puts the pack across Q122 whenever it conducts.
- BAT_IN–ACT_GATE holds Q120 and Q121 off.

Why Minor:
- All gaps are DRC-legal and the vias are tented on both sides, so a short needs a fab or mask defect, which E-test screens (Inference).
- A BAT_IN–ACT_EN adjacency at 0.301 mm already existed before fix pass 7, at ACT_EN's old via in the BAT_IN fills.

results.summary:
This is review pass 8 of the requirements and the owner deviation list, on the fix-pass-7 board (SHA c872a3d3…). The full report is at m3_design/assembly_review/sources/r7_review/pass8_docs.md. Nothing in the repository changed except that report: the board, schematic, rules and netlist hashes and git status were the same before and after.

What I re-ran and found consistent with the records:
- tools/check.sh exits 0: DRC, unconnected, parity and ERC are all 0. The routing check reports 0 failing, 45 allowlisted, 29 leftovers and 1 local bump (allowlisted as A48); the actuator and fit checks pass.
- All 178 tool tests and the 21 quality_audit tests pass. test_r5_repair still has its one known error.
- The fab manifest is bound to this board. The cost check (22:02Z) gives $105.98 per board with 52 extended codes. Stock is short only on U4.
- The deviation list's counts are correct:
  - A (allowlist): 45 entries; B (leftovers): 29, each figure equal to the gate's output.
  - E (information only): 252, split 179 critical / 73 non-critical.
  - C's 25 rows hold 225 instances, for 299 in all.
- C11 (23 / 48 thin unstitched GND pieces) and C14 (32 of 75 pieces held by a single via) reproduce.
- The pass-2 scan.py finds 904 instances; its 47 chain detours map one to one onto A34–A41, A47, C24 and C25.
- route_check --bumps-all finds exactly the two C27 items plus A48.
- Comparing gate output on the pass-7 board and the final board shows only the changes the handoff names.
- A layer-hop sweep of the seven nets with a pour finds only listed hops.

Pass-7 findings: P7-DOCS-01 (Major) is closed in copper (the extra via and both overlap-only joints are gone), in the gate (the new via_on_track check finds 0) and in the records (C23 lists the crossing). P7-DOCS-02 and P7-DOCS-03 are closed apart from small residues. Owner acceptance is still open, as recorded.

New in pass 8: 0 Critical, 0 Major, 3 Minor.
- P8-DOCS-01: deviation C15 promises every sub-0.2 mm gap that fix-pass copper created, but misses two from fix pass 7. One is a new BAT_IN via 0.188 mm from a GND pad (a short would put the battery across GND). The other is a 0.190 mm gap between CAM_5V_SENSE and a 3V3 via.
- P8-DOCS-02: some record figures and owner-summary claims are not exact:
  - a stale 8.00 mm length;
  - one location counted twice in the 299;
  - two claims that overstate (what the gate re-checks, and that the C1 necks cannot be moved);
  - one cost run missing from ORDERING;
  - the current through the six new crossbar vias is not recorded.
- P8-DOCS-03: the new legend check measures only the nearest corner of a legend. The J124 fuse note therefore ends beside J1's 15 A note, and J2's pin table is split across both faces. Cosmetic.

R7 acceptance is still not met: the owner has not accepted the deviation list (M2), and U4 has not been consigned. This dimension leaves no open Critical or Major.

findings.finding:
Fix pass 7's copper created two sub-0.2 mm gaps that are listed nowhere.

(1) The BAT_IN via at (9.45, 109.80), one of necks7's six crossbar vias (0.6 / 0.3 mm), is 0.188 mm edge to edge from R123.2 on B.Cu.
- R123 is ACT_EN's 100 kΩ pull-down, 0402, on the bottom side; R123.2 is GND.
- A short would put BAT_IN (the pack behind the external 15 A fuse) on GND. The board and the servo feed would go down until the fuse opens. It is not a fire path.
- E-test screens etched shorts, and the via is plugged and masked, so a solder bridge from the pad is improbable (Inference).

(2) CAM_5V_SENSE's new In2 diagonal (30.335, 35.835)–(34.785, 31.385), from stage sense7, is 0.190 mm from the 3V3 via (32.33, 33.042). That is the via dup7 kept. A short would tie the camera-5V sense ADC line to 3.3 V, a wrong reading. It is on In2, so only a laminate defect can make it.

Neither gap appears in:
- C15 (#1–#40);
- M3_R7's list of fix pass 7's copper (l.638–642);
- F8's newgap list (handoff §3);
- the owner summary's 'New in fix pass 7, for your attention' (l.840). That paragraph names three gaps where a short would put a higher rail on 3V3 or an MCU pin. It omits the one fix-pass-7 gap where a short would put the pack across GND.

Every other sub-0.2 mm gap from fix-pass-7 copper is listed (#18, #35–#40).

The raster-search results in their reasons are not re-run (l.866), nor is the module-keep-out reasoning of A16, A18 and A27.

(d) The summary's C1 bullet (l.824) says each neck is now set by something a bounded rework cannot move. Two of the three limits (Q120's gate pad and R120; ACT_GATE's In2 crossing) come from ACT_GATE routing. The C1 row and F8 §4 say that routing was out of scope and was not searched.
